ns2:course.label: Teaching Strategies in AGED
ns2:course.description: Synthesis of principles of teaching and learning as they influence educational activities in formal and non-formal environments within agricultural and related sciences. Gives individuals an opportunity to apply the educational concepts covered in AGED 300 or AGED 420. Individuals will design, implement, and evaluate learner-centered approaches in a variety of simulated educational environments. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: AGED 300 or AGED 420.
